design.name: counter
design.notes: The fixture proves the WIDTH=4 configuration only.

requirements.reason: The reset value is a state invariant that must hold while the asynchronous reset is asserted.

evidence.quote: While i_rst_n is low, q shall be 4'b0000.

requirements.reason: Single-clock structure is established by RTL elaboration and clock-domain checks; a temporal assertion would restate the clocking of the harness.

evidence.quote: q shall change only on the rising edge of i_clk.

requirements.reason: The increment transition is a next-cycle relation between the current and next values of q.

evidence.quote: When i_inc is 1 and q is not 15, q shall increment by 1 on the next rising edge of i_clk.

requirements.reason: The hold behavior is a next-cycle relation; it is the complement of the increment transition.

evidence.quote: When i_inc is 0, q shall hold its value on the next rising edge of i_clk.

requirements.reason: The wrap transition is a next-cycle relation at the maximum value.

evidence.quote: When i_inc is 1 and q is 15, q shall wrap to 0 on the next rising edge of i_clk.

requirements.reason: The reachability scenario is checked by a cover property so that the transition properties are not vacuous.

evidence.quote: A cycle with i_inc 1 and q 0 shall be reachable after reset.

requirements.reason: The output width is a structural/elaboration fact; it is checked by the interface extractor and by the exact port mapping of the harness.

evidence.quote: The counter output q shall be WIDTH bits wide.

properties.title: Reset drives q to zero while i_rst_n is low

evidence.quote: While i_rst_n is low, q shall be 4'b0000.

properties.title: An increment below the maximum adds exactly one

evidence.quote: When i_inc is 1 and q is not 15, q shall increment by 1 on the next rising edge of i_clk.

properties.title: Without an increment q holds its value

evidence.quote: When i_inc is 0, q shall hold its value on the next rising edge of i_clk.

properties.title: An increment at the maximum wraps to zero

evidence.quote: When i_inc is 1 and q is 15, q shall wrap to 0 on the next rising edge of i_clk.

properties.title: An increment at zero is reachable after reset

evidence.quote: A cycle with i_inc 1 and q 0 shall be reachable after reset.

proven: BMC from a 2-cycle reset sequence at depth 8
Temporal induction with history skips when the property is inductive
not_proven: Other WIDTH values are not covered by this contract.
The single-clock structure (REQ-002) and the port width (REQ-007) are elaboration facts, not temporal proofs.
